concurrency_parity.note: run_document is one task; each await is sequential, so no interleaving to model

cancel_drain_parity.note: lost call (model_error) modelled in both stages, with restore and floor block; incomplete_response is a non-lost outcome (not in the model's outcome set: turn_limit stands for every non-finished, non-lost stop)
